'''May 2000 Joliet tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Joliet, Illinois on 27 May 2000. It is known from Paul Motz's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d821">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-29-wheaton-illinois-5-28-2000d821/ wheaton-illinois-5-28-2000], DeckTech (Paul "Vollerian" Motz, 29 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-29-wheaton-illinois-5-28-2000d821/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 May 2000
* '''Site:''' Joliet, Illinois
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
